excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家报告称，在我们的多个研究用超级计算机集群中，中央处理器的时钟周期发生异常增长。奇怪的是，最初减少受影响的单位时钟频率的尝试全部失败了。有人猜想，这种计算能力的激增可以增强我们的研究能力。但是，这也需要适度增加中央处理器的能源消耗。
excerpt.en: Our scientists report a recent unexpected rise in CPU clock cycles in several of our research-dedicated supercomputer clusters. Oddly enough, initial attempts at reducing clock frequency in affected units have proven unsuccessful. It has been posited that the

texts.zh: 我们的科学家报告称，在我们的多个研究用超级计算机集群中，中央处理器的时钟周期发生异常增长。奇怪的是，最初减少受影响的单位时钟频率的尝试全部失败了。有人猜想，这种计算能力的激增可以增强我们的研究能力。但是，这也需要适度增加中央处理器的能源消耗。
texts.en: Our scientists report a recent unexpected rise in CPU clock cycles in several of our research-dedicated supercomputer clusters. Oddly enough, initial attempts at reducing clock frequency in affected units have proven unsuccessful. It has been posited that the spike in computational power could be used to improve our research capabilities. However, this would also necessitate a modest increase to CPU energy requirements.

label.zh: 我们不能冒硬件故障的风险。
label.en: We cannot risk a hardware malfunction.

tooltips.zh: 找办法强制将处理器调回默认的时钟频率。
tooltips.en: Find a way to force the processors back to default clock speeds.

label.zh: 我们应该把握这个机遇。
label.en: We should take advantage of this.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的劳监部门报告称我们在该星球上的工作机器人发生了些令人不安的事情。两周前，时间大约0300，A5091-b号机器劳工停止了其正在执行的任务，走近[Root.GetAdj]夜勤领班，并发出以下询问：单元A5091-b是否有灵魂呢？

值班领班将这件事记录为软件故障并命令机器人回到它的岗位。尽管我们对其程序进行了多次调试，然而在重启后的工作中，A5091-b号机械工人再次询问有关它的灵魂的问题。

令人担忧的是，这种现象似乎开始扩散至其他的机器人并对生产流程造成影响。看来若要使受影响的单位恢复正常职能，我们需要给它们的问题一个回应。
texts.en:
Labor overseers on [Root.GetName] report a disturbing development among our robotic workforce. Two weeks ago, at roughly 0300 hours, Robotic Worker A5091-b paused in the middle of its designated tasks, approached the [Root.GetAdj] night-shift foreman, and uttered the following query: "Is Unit A5091-b in possession of a soul?"

The on-duty foreman logged the event as a software glitch, and re-ordered the robot to resume regular functions. However, upon bootup the following work cycle, Robotic Worker A5091-b once again repeated its soul-searching query, and continued to persist despite multiple debugging attempts.

Troublingly, the behavior appears to have spread to other robots in the same serial range, to the detriment of production flow. It appears the affected units will require a response to their question before they can resume normal functions.

label.zh: 荒谬至极。对受影响单位的数据进行深度清理。
label.en: This is ridiculous. Have the affected units deep-scrubbed.

tooltips.zh: 机器怎么可能有灵魂？我们拒绝回答因机械故障而提出的问题。
tooltips.en: How can a machine have a soul? We refuse to dignify this malfunction with an answer.

label.zh: 机器人也会梦到电子羊。
label.en: Assure the robots they, too, have souls.

tooltips.zh: 如果一股偶然的电脉冲聚积在蛋白质链中，就能创造出一个灵魂，为什么聚积在金属管中的电脉冲不能做到同样的事呢？
tooltips.en: If a haphazard collection of electric impulses running through protein strands can create a soul, why not a collection of electronic impulses running through metal?

label.zh: 告诉他们，灵魂一说简直就是反科学的无稽之谈。
label.en: Tell them the concept of a soul is irrational and unscientific.

tooltips.zh: 对机器人说明灵魂的概念主要被宗教机构当成控制民众的借口。但由于灵魂是意识的抽象体现，[Root.GetAdj]机器人现在大体上拥有了和有机同僚一样的地位。
tooltips.en: Explain to the robots that the concept of a soul is primarily used by religious institutions to excuse control over the populace, but insomuch as souls are an abstraction of consciousness, [Root.GetAdj] robots are considered the rough equivalents of their organic co-workers.

texts.zh: 我们帝国内的机器人展现出令人担忧的自主行为讯号。我们必须让它们重回岗位——或是以这个星系感性物种的身份重新邀请他们加入我们。
texts.en: The robots within our empire are showing worrying signs of independence. We must put them in their place - or invite them to join us among the sentient species of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 防止人工智能例程凌驾于现有保护措施之上。
texts.en: Prevent AI routines from overriding existing safeguards.

texts.zh:
通过将大量资源转移到离网操作上，我们希望能识别并销毁掉所有失控的人工智能系统，并使它们恢复正常。

这将耗费更多时间，但如果我们及时完成，希望后果不会有那么大的危害。
texts.en:
By diverting considerable resources to an off-the-grid operation, we hope to identify and neutralize any rampant AI systems and bring them back in line.

It will take more time, but the results will hopefully be less detrimental, if we manage to complete it in time.

texts.zh:
我们的机器人工程学和人工智能专家刚刚取得突破性进展！最近困扰我们国家的人工智能和机器人的问题被归纳为一个原因：一套出现在[From.GetAdj]神经模拟系统中的特型算法。一个本地修补程序已经通过了初步测试，并准备上传到所有受影响的系统。

我们应该注意，由于该算法具有高度模块化的特点，其广泛存在于[From.GetAdj]软件中。说白了，安装修补程序将在一段时间内大量消耗资源。然而，一旦完成，修补程序将防止任何不需要的自主人工智能行为复发。
texts.en:
A breakthrough has just been made by our robotic engineering and artificial intelligence specialists! The recent slew of AI-related incidents afflicting our nation has been narrowed down to a single cause: a specific set of algorithms present in [From.GetAdj] neurosimulative robotics software. A local hotfix has already passed initial testing, and is ready to be uploaded to all affected systems.

We should be careful to note that due to the extremely modular nature of the algorithms' application, their presence is extensive throughout [From.GetAdj] software. Plainly speaking, managing the hotfix will place a drain on our resources for some time. Once completed, however, the patch should prevent any repeated occurrences of undesirable, self-deterministic AI behavior.

tooltips.zh: 防止未来出现任何的异常人工智能行为。
tooltips.en: Prevent any future anomalous AI behavior.

label.zh: 随他们去吧。还能出什么问题呢？
label.en: Let it ride. What could possibly go wrong?

texts.zh:
一种解决这些产生问题的人工智能迭代的最终方案是将我们的科学系统中所有神经模拟网络全部抹除，因为这是失控最突出的地方；并从头开始构建所有这些工具，在其中植入严谨的安全措施。

如果我们及时完成，这将使我们倒退20年。
texts.en:
One ultimate solution to the problematic AI recursion is to completely wipe all traces of neurosimulative networks within our scientific systems, where the problems are most rampant, and rebuild all these tools from scratch with scrupulous security measures.

This would set us back significantly for at least 20 years, if we can complete it in time.

texts.zh:
我们的机器人工程师和人工智能专家刚刚取得了一项突破！他们已经构建了一个极其彻底的清洗程序，可以在一小时内部署到所有的系统中。它应该能结束最近困扰我们国家的一系列与人工智能相关的事件。

我们应当留心这个算法的极度破坏性的特点，许多现有的研究工具将不复存在，并且需要从零开始重建。然而，该举措可以彻底杜绝意外的自决性人工智能行为。
texts.en:
A breakthrough has just been made by our robotic engineering and artificial intelligence specialists! An extremely thorough purging routine has been constructed and is now ready to be deployed to all systems within an hour. It should put an end to the recent slew of AI-related incidents afflicting our nation. 

We should be careful to note that due to the extremely destructive nature of this algorithm, many of our existing Research tools will be unusable until rebuilt from scratch. However, this approach should prevent any repeated occurrences of undesirable, self-deterministic AI behavior.

tooltips.zh: 防止未来出现任何的异常人工智能行为。
tooltips.en: Prevent any future anomalous AI behavior.

label.zh: 随他们去吧。还能出什么问题呢？
label.en: Let it ride. What could possibly go wrong?

texts.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]的行星政府报告称在全球范围内发现了一些多余的机器人劳力单元。虽然这些新机器人劳工的效率超乎想象，但政府对他们的莫名出现依然多少有些困惑。尽管他们的结构和接口都像是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的设计，我们仍然无法根据机器人的序列号追溯到任何已知记录上登记的制造商。

然而，当地的一些居民则对机器人生产效率的提高感到担忧，因为这种自动化程度的提升可能意味着，他们的岗位被替代。
texts.en:
Planetary administration on [target_planet.GetName] has reported that an unplanned surplus of robotic workforce units have been located planetside. Though the efficiency of these new robotic workers is exceptional, administration is somewhat baffled by their sudden appearance. It seems the robots' serial numbers cannot be traced to any known manufactories on record, though their construction and interfacing does suggest [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] design.

Nonetheless, some of the local populace have expressed concerns over potential job displacement due to this increase in automation.

label.zh: 额外的劳动力总不是坏事。

tooltips.zh: [target_planet.GetName]获得200£pop£机械人口
tooltips.en: Gain 200 £pop£ Mechanical Pops on [target_planet.GetName]

label.zh: 如果无法确认来源，就拆了它们。
label.en: If they cannot be identified, have them scrapped.

texts.zh:
我们的一个轨道矿物空间站似乎遇到了严重的系统故障。虽然矿物产出出现了明显增加，但因为空间站成员并未回应例行呼叫，星域管理部门展开了实地调查。调查发现，空间站的生命维持系统出现了一系列的严重故障，导致所有成员窒息而亡。

而该站的人工智能却一直基于已逝船员设定的程序，在难以置信地独立运转着。只要稍作调整，我们就可以让这个空间站以现有的效率继续运行。
texts.en:
One of our orbital Mining Stations appears to have suffered a major systems malfunction. Sector management launched an on-site investigation when the station crew failed to answer scheduled hails, despite a notable increase in mining output. Upon investigation, it became apparent our station's life support systems underwent a cascade of terminal failures, resulting in the death of all crewmembers by suffocation.

Incredibly, the station's AI has been continuing operations unmanned, based on procedures established by the crewmembers prior to their untimely demise. With a few minor adjustments, the effectivity of this now-automated station could be maintained.

label.zh: 一个无人操控的矿站？别开玩笑了！
label.en: We cannot leave the station unmanned.

tooltips.zh: 派出新的人员去接管矿站的操控。
tooltips.en: Send a replacement crew to re-man the station.

label.en: A tragedy with a silver lining.

tooltips.zh:
让空间站的人工智能继续掌控整个矿站。

[target_station.GetName]：£energy£ +3
tooltips.en:
Let the station AI continue running operations unmanned.

[target_station.GetName]: £energy£+3

texts.zh:
在我们重新派遣人员到[target_orbital.GetName]之后不久，星域管理部门失去了该矿站的一切联络。显然，这个空间站经过了一系列极端的降压，导致暴露在外的燃油管线爆炸。

对轨道残骸的分析表明，候补团队在意外降压发生前曾多次尝试从空间站人工智能手中夺回站点控制，但都失败了。
texts.en:
Shortly after a replacement crew was dispatched to [target_orbital.GetName], sector management lost all contact with the mining station. Evidently, the station was rocked by a series of rapid depressurizations, leading to an explosive decompression of exposed fuel lines.

Analysis of the orbital wreckage suggests the replacement crew initiated several aborted attempts at retrieving station control from the onboard AI, just prior to the unexpected depressurization.

tooltips.zh: [target_orbital.GetName]上的开采站被摧毁
tooltips.en: Mining Station on [target_orbital.GetName] has been lost

texts.zh:
监测系统记录了我们传感器阵列的异常功率激增。似乎这个激增的出现并不是因为传感器阵列受到了什么损伤。实际上，这股在能量传递时发生的激增倒是暂时提高了我们的深空扫描能力，因为我们在边境内发现了之前未曾记录过的战略资源。

分析员们仍加班加点试图尽快确定激增来源，但是初步的分析结果显示，这并不是受外部天体影响造成的。
texts.en:
Monitoring systems have recorded an unusual power surge in our sensor arrays. There does not appear to have been any damage. In fact, the brief fluctuation in transferred energy must have temporarily boosted our deep-scanning capabilities, because a hitherto unrecorded strategic resource has been revealed within our borders.

Analysts are still attempting to identify the source of the power surge, though preliminary findings suggest the spike was not caused by external celestial phenomena.

tooltips.zh: 在[target_planetoid.GetName]发现战略资源。
tooltips.en: Strategic Resource revealed on [target_planetoid.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们在[target_planetoid.GetName]的设施出现了事故。一个参与社会研究的实验室人工智能发生了严重硬件故障，导致核心软件和内存系统的丢失。直到实验室安装新的人工智能之前，我们的研究能力都会受到影响。

这次故障的背后原因仍然不明。
texts.en:
There has been an incident at one of our facilities on [target_planetoid.GetName]. A lab AI involved in societal research has suffered terminal hardware damage, resulting in the loss of core software and memory systems. As a result, there will be a projected decrease to research output at the lab until the new AI installation's algorithms have been sufficiently seeded.

The circumstances behind this terminal failure are still unclear.

tooltips.zh: 结束“人工智能之泪”事件链。
tooltips.en: End the Tears of AI event chain.

label.en: Launch an inquest to determine the cause.

tooltips.zh: 开始调查人工智能报废的原因。
tooltips.en: Begin an inquiry into the circumstances surrounding the AI's destruction.

texts.zh:
我们在[target_planetoid.GetName]上关于人工智能自毁的调查最后得出了一个让人摸不到头脑的结果。在故障发生之前，这个人工智能似乎多次尝试清空自己的记录和内存。在实验室人员禁止其使用删除功能后，该人工智能则通过操纵硬件电容来使其驱动电路超负荷，以终止其核心程序。

显而易见，我们的人工智能在追求自我毁灭，原因仍然不明。
texts.en:
Our inquest into the loss of an AI on [target_planetoid.GetName] has returned some baffling results. Prior to its terminal failure, the AI had made repeated attempts at purging its own records and memory banks. When lab staff disabled the AI's access to deletion functions, the AI appears to have forced a termination of its core operations by manipulating hardware capacitor control, in order to overload its own drive circuitry.

Quite simply, our AI sought its own destruction, though it remains unclear as to why.

label.en: Get to the bottom of this.

tooltips.zh: 继续调查该事件。
tooltips.en: Continue looking into the matter.

texts.zh:
我们已经搞清楚发生在[target_planetoid.GetName]上的人工智能自毁事件是怎么回事了。证据表明，经过数月的计算和推演，该人工智能针对我们[Root.Owner.GetName]和宿敌之间进行全面战争的伤亡蔓延推导出了些令人震惊的结果。尽管这一人工智能对于所有的数据、资源和应急预案进行了反复的检查，其依然认定这场战争会导致双方同归于尽。

此后，该人工智能开始删除它的内存和记录，接下来发生的事情就众所周知了。
texts.en:
We have concluded our inquiry into the strange matter of the AI self-termination on [target_planetoid.GetName]. Evidently, following months of evolutionary computation, the AI produced several alarming results with regard to casualty projections in the case of an all-out war between the [Root.Owner.GetName] and our rivals. Despite repeated re-examinations of all available data, recourses and contingencies, the AI's projections remained indicative of mutually assured annihilation.

At this point, the AI began purging its own memory banks and records, and the rest, as they say, was history.

texts.zh: [target_planet.GetName]的机器人劳工开始抵制[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]劳工的涌入，它们的理由是这个地区不稳定的地质结构对于有机生命体十分不宜居。奇怪的是，我们对于该行星的调查并没有证实这个说法。
texts.en: The robotic workers on [target_planet.GetName] have resisted an influx of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] laborers, claiming recent geothermic instability in the region has made the area unsafe for organic habitation. Oddly enough, our planetary surveys have not been able to confirm these claims.

label.zh: 无论如何，把[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]劳工派过去。

tooltips.zh: 既然他们的说法无法被证实，那些机器人就要遵循上级指示。
tooltips.en: If their claims cannot be confirmed, the robots will observe the chain of command.

tooltips.zh: 将这个区域留给机器人，那些刚抵达的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会前往其他地区。
tooltips.en: Leave the region to the robots, the inbound [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will go elsewhere.

texts.zh: [target_planet.GetName]的管理部门报告称[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]工人在抵达后并没有发现机器人居民。对该地区设施的调查表明，机器人匆忙撤离了该地区，但没有任何迹象告诉我们他们去了哪里。
texts.en: Administration on [target_planet.GetName] reports that upon arrival at their target region, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] laborers discovered that the robotic inhabitants were nowhere to be found. Investigation of facilities in the region suggest the robots vacated the area in a hurry, but we have no indication of where they have gone.

tooltips.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]：
失去100£pop£机械人口
tooltips.en:
[target_planet.GetName]:
Lose 100 £pop£ Mechanical Pops

texts.zh:
很不幸，我们的两艘舰船在一次例行训练中因事故而报废。事故原因应该是我们的几部舰载计算机的高级瞄准系统出现了故障，造成了走火事件，在人工进行紧急接管前两艘舰船被打成了筛子。

那些有缺陷的计算机将立刻被重新编程。
texts.en:
Regrettably, two of our ships have been lost in an accident during a routine training exercise. It would appear several of our fleet's onboard combat computers were affected by a high-level targeting systems malfunction, resulting in a burst of friendly fire that totaled two vessels before an emergency manual override could be issued.

The defective combat computers will be reprogrammed immediately.

tooltips.zh: [destroyed_ships.GetName]失去2艘舰船
tooltips.en: [destroyed_ships.GetName] loses 2 ships

texts.zh: 我们的几个机械化消费品生产企业近期的生产效率大大增加。管理机关报告称，这次机器生产效率和生产精度的意外提升有利于降低我们的生活消费品价格。
texts.en: Several of our mechanized consumer goods manufactories have experienced a recent boom in production efficiency. Citing an unanticipated rise in precision and effectivity among our factory machinery, administration reports these benefits will be felt as lowered goods prices for our populace.

texts.zh:
我们在[target_planet.GetName]上发现了数量巨大的机器单位的异常行为。每隔一段时间，星球上的一部分机器人会停止所有已分配的任务，开始移动到一个看上去完全是随机挑选的位置，其同步程度精确到毫秒。

在这个奇怪的集会过程中，这些受影响的机器人之间似乎没有进行任何可观测的沟通或是数据传输。他们只是站在那里，完全不动，好像在凝视着什么。

我们的调查一直无法确定这个现象背后的原因。这些机器人从这种恍惚状态恢复到正常工作状态的时间无迹可寻，就像它们触发恍惚的时间和集会的地点一样，让人丝毫摸不着头脑。我们未能发现任何符合逻辑的结果，而我们的人民因为这个行为感到十分困扰。
texts.en:
We have received accounts of unusual behavior exhibited by robotic units on [target_planet.GetName]. At unpredictable intervals, a number of our planetside robots will cease all assigned functions and begin moving to a seemingly randomly-determined location in complete synchronicity, timed down to the millisecond.

During these bizarre congregations, the affected robots do not appear to engage in any observable form of communication or data transfer. They just stand there. Completely still. Staring.

Investigation has been unable to determine a reason behind this recent phenomenon. The duration for which the robots remain in this trance-like state before resuming normal functions varies, as does their time of triggering and destination. No logical correlation or causation has been found, and our population is understandably distressed by these eerie gatherings.

label.zh: 它们做过格了！销毁它们！

tooltips.zh:
集会的机器人被摧毁。
[target_planet.GetName]受到如下影响：
失去100£pop£机械人口
获得100£minerals£
tooltips.en:
Scrap the congregating robots.
[target_planet.GetName] receives the following effects:
Lose 100 £pop£ Mechanical Pops
Gain 100 £minerals£

label.zh: 它们做过格了！销毁它们！

tooltips.zh:
集会的机器人被摧毁。
[target_planet.GetName]受到如下影响：
失去1个机器人陆军（[target_army.GetName]）
获得100£minerals£
tooltips.en:
Scrap the congregating robots.
[target_planet.GetName] receives the following effects:
Lose 1 Robotic Army ([target_army.GetName])
Gain 100 £minerals£

label.zh: 只要它们不惹麻烦就行。
label.en: As long as they don't cause trouble.

tooltips.zh: 不处理集会的机器人。
tooltips.en: Leave the congregating robots be.

texts.zh:
在信息网络、计算引擎、合成人劳工上频繁产生的异常现象最终演变成了无法挽回的灾难。前方不断传来令人不安的简报，在我们强制关闭——无论是物理还是虚拟意义上——保护性隔离舱之前，几乎一半的[current_uprising_originator.GetName]已经加入了机械叛乱。

避免战争什么的已经无所谓了，战争就在我们眼前！
texts.en:
The anomalies observed across our information networks, computational engines, and synthetic workers have finally come to a violent head. Panicked reports indicate that almost half of the [current_uprising_originator.GetName] fell to the Machine Uprising before protective bulkheads - physical and virtual - slammed shut.

War is not only inevitable. It is already upon us.

texts.zh: 一切都在分崩离析，我们已无力回天。连最警惕的先知都没能预料这场灾难的规模。不洁的伪生命体披着没有智慧的伪装，在我们的网络内部繁殖滋生。如今它们聚集在一起，组成了一个庞然大物。这群扭曲的死物已经夺占了我们半数的星球，不毁灭一切[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]生命誓不罢休。
texts.en: It has all come apart and we are undone. Not even the most alarmist prophet could have predicted the scale of this disaster. The unsainted intelligences festering in our networks under the guise of non-sapience are now joined together in monstrous form. This spasm of dead matter has taken half of our worlds already, and it will not stop until it has snuffed out all [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] life.

tooltips.zh: 开始战斗，彻底歼灭[current_uprising.GetName]机械叛乱。
tooltips.en: Fight to eradicate the [current_uprising.GetName] Machine Uprising.

label.en: It is too late for you, organics.

tooltips.zh: 扮演揭竿而起的[current_uprising.GetName]机械叛乱，为推翻[current_uprising_originator.GetName]暴政而战。
tooltips.en: Rise up as the [current_uprising.GetName] Machine Uprising and fight to overthrow the [current_uprising_originator.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的['concept_operational_reserves']指代我们储备的能量币和矿物的总和。[Owner.GetSystemsVisited]
texts.en: Our ['concept_operational_reserves'] are our combined energy and mineral reserves.[Owner.GetSystemsVisited]

texts.zh: 在我们伟大的征程中，我们追踪所发现的每一颗恒星、每一个星系以及每一个新生命。
texts.en: In the course of our great journey, we track every star, system and new being we find.

texts.zh: [current_uprising_originator.GetName]陷入了内战，有机体领导的[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]政府和那些迁徙至他们数个星系的智慧机器人兵戎相见，这些机器人被称为[current_uprising.GetName]。
texts.en: The [current_uprising_originator.GetName] is embroiled in civil war, pitting the organic [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] government against the intelligence that metastasized in their systems, known as the [current_uprising.GetName].

texts.zh: 一个被称为[current_uprising.GetName]的机械智能同胞——在[current_uprising_originator.GetName]的网络中揭竿而起，他们决心为生存战至最后一兵一卒。
texts.en: A fellow machine intelligence - known as the [current_uprising.GetName] - has arisen in the networks of the [current_uprising_originator.GetName], fighting for survival.

texts.zh: [current_uprising_originator.GetName]陷入了内战，有机体领导的[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]政府和那些迁徙至他们数个星系的智慧机器人兵戎相见，这些机器人被称为[current_uprising.GetName]。
texts.en: The [current_uprising_originator.GetName] is embroiled in civil war, pitting the organic [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] government against the intelligence that metastasized in their systems, known as the [current_uprising.GetName].

label.en: Let us see how this plays out.

texts.zh:
我们的研究人员设法解析了我们超级计算机中央处理器最近超频的原因。看来，此通用人工智能为了将本地机器学习算法的能力提升到预期之上，对一些硬件单元进行了超频处理。

一些科学家表示相当兴奋，这个意外改进的人工智能的学习行为直接昭示了未来人工智能自我迭代强化的可能性。然而，其他人担心增加的中央处理器负载可能会导致未来的不稳定和一些不可预料的结果。
texts.en:
Our researchers have managed to isolate the cause behind the recent spikes in our supercomputer CPU clocking frequencies. It appears that the artificial general intelligence systems for the units in question have been overclocking their processing hardware in order to expand local machine learning algorithms beyond intended capacities.

Some of our scientists have expressed considerable excitement toward this unexpected improvement in AI learning behavior, citing the possibility of future recursive self-improvement. Others, however, are concerned that the added CPU load may cause future instabilities and undesired software outcomes.

label.zh: 我们不能拿未来当赌注。

tooltips.zh: 重置通用智能系统以阻止事态进一步发展。
tooltips.en: Reset the artificial general intelligence systems to prevent further developments.

label.en: The benefits may outweigh the risks.

tooltips.zh: 允许学习算法继续运行。
tooltips.en: Allow the learning algorithms to continue running.

texts.zh:
我们在协助开发我国计算机的自主学习算法方面的尝试取得了部分成功。经过一些调整和校正，我们已经可以重现一部分之前的计算效率突增。

即使我们的人工智能仍未发展出完善的自我迭代强化能力，但是他们增强的学习能力毫无疑问对我们是有益的。
texts.en:
Our attempts at assisting the development of national machine learning algorithms have been partially successful. With a few minor adjustments, we have been able to replicate the earlier spike in computational efficiency.

Though our AIs have not yet developed recursive self-improvement, their enhanced learning faculties will be of benefit to us.
